output.subject: Your feedback about resetting your debit card PIN
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us about your debit card. You told us your card was locked after three incorrect PIN attempts at an ATM. You then needed to call us to have the attempts reset before you could set a new PIN by phone.

You mentioned that you were unhappy about having to call, and that next time you would like to be able to sort this out at the ATM itself. We understand how inconvenient it is to be unable to use your card and to have to stop and phone us when you would rather resolve things on the spot. We're sorry for the frustration this caused.

We have passed your feedback to our Card Services team for review, including your request to be able to reset your PIN at an ATM in future. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

In the meantime, if you have any further trouble using your card, please get in touch with us.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the card is now fully unlocked and the new PIN is working before sending.
Decide whether to explain any existing self-service PIN reset options (ATM, app or online), if the bank offers them.
Decide how to respond to the request for ATM-based PIN reset: product feedback only, or a specific answer.
The call note says the issue was resolved on the call; consider whether a shorter acknowledgement is more appropriate.
The draft does not explain why the card locks after three attempts. Add a security explanation if you want to.
